blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) on resource-constrained embodied agents for 3D visual question answering necessitates cloud-edge collaboration. However, offloading massive visual data to the cloud over bandwidth-limited and noisy channels introduces severe latency and transmission distortion. To address this, we propose TP-JSCC, an efficient token pruning and joint source-channel coding method for LVLMs-based 3D-VQA in Cloud-Edge Collaboration. First, we develop a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module to significantly reduce the visual token count. By decoupling foreground-background tokens and jointly selecting local and global semantics, LGS-HTP effectively reduces redundancy while preserving reasoning-critical tokens. Second, we introduce a lightweight Token Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module to further compress the pruned tokens and ensure their robust transmission over error-prone channels. By employing lightweight cascaded linear layers and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR)-adaptive mechanism, this module adapts to fluctuating channel conditions while maintaining minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on ScanQA and SQA3D datasets indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of our approach. Specifically, on ScanQA validation set, the LGS-HTP module could achieve 90% pruning ratio while incurring less than a 1% CIDEr loss. Building on this, the T-JSCC further compresses the tokens by 18 times, resulting in an overall 180 times data volume reduction for robust transmission, while saving 90% in computational complexity for LVLM deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC.
blocks.zh: 在资源受限的内含物剂上部署大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs),用于3D视觉问题的回答,需要开展多云的合作。 然而,通过带宽有限和吵闹的通道将大量视觉数据卸载到云中,造成了严重的延迟和传输扭曲. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出TP-JSCC,一种高效的代号回推和以LVLMs为基础的Cloud-Edge Complex中的3D-VQA的源-通道联合编码方法. 首先,我们开发一个基于本地和全球语义学的Hybrid Token Pruning(LGS-HTP)模块,以显著地减少视觉符号计数. LGS-HTP通过脱钩前地-后地符号并联合选择本地和全球语义来有效减少冗余,同时保留推理-关键符号. 其次,我们引入了轻量级Token 联合源码-通道编码模块(T-JSCC)来进一步压缩被刷音符,并确保它们在容易出错的频道上进行强大的传输. 通过使用轻量级相接线性地层和信号-噪声比(SNR)-适应机制,本模块适应了波动的通道条件,同时保持了最小的计算间接费用. 对ScanQA和SQA3D数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法具有特殊的效率和稳健性。 具体地说,在ScanQA验证集中,LGS-HTP模块可以实现90%的穿行率,同时产生不到1%的CIDEr损失. 在此基础上,T-JSCC进一步将信使压缩了18倍,导致数据量总体减少180倍以进行强力传输,同时为LVLM部署节省了90%的计算复杂性. 我们的代码见https://github.com/yuanhui0325/TP-JSCC。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved unprecedented advancements, driven by an exponential increase in computational power and the surge of large-scale datasets. These models exhibit excellent capabilities in multimodal understanding and reasoning, significantly enhancing the cognitive competence of embodied agents (EAs) [ 1 ] . Particularly in unstructured environments requiring complex reasoning, such as 3D Visual Question Answering (3D-VQA), conventional lightweight models are limited by shallow semantic representations and often fail to capture robust cross-modal correspondences. In contrast, LVLMs leverage extensive prior knowledge to achieve superior cross-modal alignment [ 2 ] . Consequently, integrating LVLMs into EAs is an inevitable trend toward general-purpose embodied intelligence.
blocks.zh: 大型Vision-Langage Models(LVLMs)在计算功率指数增长和大规模数据集激增的推动下,取得了前所未有的进步. 这些模型在多式联运理解和推理方面展现了卓越的能力,大大提高了所体现物剂的认知能力[1]。 特别是在需要复杂推理的无结构环境中,如3D视觉问答(3D-VQA),常规轻量级模型受到浅语义表达的限制,往往无法捕捉到强力的跨模式函证. 与此相反,LVLMs利用广泛的先前知识来实现优异的跨模式对齐[2]. 因此,将LVLMs纳入EAs是不可避免的趋势,即实现包含在一般目的中的智能。

blocks.en: However, the remarkable capabilities of LVLMs come at the cost of substantial computational overhead. Most EAs, such as intelligent drones and domestic service robots, are subject to strict physical constraints, including size, thermal limits, and battery power, rendering on-device LVLM inference computationally prohibitive. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a Cloud-Edge Collaborative Paradigm (CE-CP) for EAs [ 3 ] . In this paradigm, EAs function as edge terminals focusing on data acquisition, compression, and transmission, while resource-abundant cloud servers execute the LVLM inference.
blocks.zh: 然而,LVLM的显著能力是以大量的计算间接费用为代价的。 大多数EA,例如智能无人机和家用服务机器人,都受到严格的物理限制,包括体积,热限,和电池功率,使设备上的LVLM推论在计算上令人望而却步. 因此,有必要为职业介绍所开发一个云端合作范式。 在这个范式中,EAs作为边缘终端功能,专注于数据获取,压缩,传输,而资源丰富的云服务器则执行LVLM推论.

blocks.en: Although CE-CP avoids the on-device computational bottlenecks, it shifts the heavy burden to the communication channels. In error-prone communication environments, such as post-disaster rescue and deep-well exploration, communication channels are typically plagued by severe channel noise and strictly limited bandwidth. Under such conditions, directly transmitting raw high-resolution visual data becomes intractable. Specifically, the massive volume of raw pixels incurs unacceptable latency, while their inherent vulnerability to noise leads to severe transmission distortion, degrading the inference performance of LVLMs. Therefore, robust Joint Source-Channel Coding (JSCC) paradigms are necessary to ensure reliable transmission.
blocks.zh: 虽然CE-CP避免了在线计算瓶颈,但它将沉重的负担转移到了通信渠道. 在灾害后救援和深井探索等容易发生错误的通信环境中,通信通道通常受到严重信道噪声和严格限制带宽的困扰. 在这种情况下,直接传送原始高分辨率的视觉数据变得棘手。 具体来说,大量原始像素会产生无法接受的耐久性,而它们固有的易受噪声影响会导致严重的传播扭曲,使LVLM的推论性能下降. 因此,为确保可靠的传输,必须采用强有力的源码-通道编码(JSCC)模式。

blocks.en: However, before designing the coding scheme, a fundamental question must be addressed: whether to compress raw visual pixels or their higher-level semantic representations (i.e., visual tokens). Compressing visual tokens offers three distinct advantages. First, visual encoders intrinsically filter out pixel-level noise and spatial redundancy, yielding a highly compact representation that optimizes bandwidth utilization at the source. Second, despite being distilled features, tokens retain structured correlations within the semantic space, unlocking the potential for deep compression far beyond the theoretical limits of pixel-level coding. Third, as latent representations, visual tokens are highly non-invertible, which substantially mitigates the risk of privacy leakage. Therefore, from the perspectives of both communication efficiency and privacy preservation, transmitting compressed visual tokens emerges as a highly effective paradigm [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,在设计编码方案之前,必须解决一个根本问题:是压缩原始视觉像素还是压缩其更高层次的语义表达(即视觉符号). 压缩视觉符号提供了三个显著的优势. 首先,视觉编码器内在地过滤出像素级噪声和空间冗余,产生高度紧凑的表示,优化了源头的带宽利用率. 其次,尽管是蒸馏的特征,但令牌在语义空间中保留了结构上的关联性,解开了深度压缩的潜力,远远超出了像素级编码的理论极限. 第三,视觉标志作为潜在的表示,是高度不可逆的,大大降低了隐私泄露的风险。 因此,从通信效率和隐私保护的角度来看,传送压缩的视觉信号是一个非常有效的范例[4、5、6、7]。

blocks.en: To fully exploit the transmission potential of visual tokens over bandwidth-limited and error-prone communication channels, we propose an efficient token pruning and JSCC method for LVLM-based 3D-VQA in cloud-edge collaboration, named TP-JSCC. It effectively tackles the core bottlenecks of redundancy and distortion through two collaborative modules. First, to fundamentally eliminate token-level redundancy, we propose a Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Pruning (LGS-HTP) module. By explicitly decoupling foreground from background tokens and jointly preserving local and global semantics, this module effectively mitigates the severe performance degradation of LVLM typically induced by massive pruning. Second, to further mitigate feature-level redundancy within the pruned tokens and enhance transmission robustness, we propose a Token-based Joint Source-Channel Coding (T-JSCC) module. Constrained by the limited computational capacity of EAs, T-JSCC adopts an all-linear cascaded architecture to ensure minimal on-device overhead. Furthermore, it incorporates a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) adaptive mechanism to dynamically mitigate the impact of fluctuating channel noise, ensuring robust token reconstruction at the cloud server. The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 为了充分利用视觉信使在带宽有限和容易出错的通信通道上的传输潜力,我们提议在云端合作中为基于LVLM的3D-VQA提供高效信使查询和JSC方法,命名为TP-JSCC. 它通过两个协作模块有效地解决冗余和扭曲的核心瓶颈。 首先,为了从根本上消除符号级冗余,我们提议一个基于本地和全球语义的混合Token Pruning(LGS-HTP)模块. 这个模块通过明确将前景与背景符号脱钩,并共同维护当地和全球语义,有效缓解了LVLM通常由大规模挤压引起的严重性能退化。 第二,为了进一步减少被刷音符内特性级的冗余,增强传输稳健性,我们提议采用基于Token的源-源码联合模块。 由于EAs的计算能力有限,T-JSCC采用了全线级阶梯式架构,以确保最小的安装机顶. 此外,它还采用了信号对噪声比率(SNR)适应机制,以动态地减轻变化的信道噪声的影响,确保云端服务器的信号重建。 本文件的主要贡献概述如下。

blocks.en: 1) TP-JSCC method: To address LVLM inference demands under on-device computational constraints and severely noisy, low-bandwidth communication channels, we propose an efficient token pruning and JSCC method. The edge device handles token compression, while the cloud server performs decoding and complex LVLM inference, effectively offloading the computational burden away from the edge.
blocks.zh: (1) TP-JSCC方法: 为了解决LVLM推论在设备计算限制和严重吵闹的低频段通信通道下的要求,我们提议一种有效的代号推算和JSC方法. 边缘设备处理符号压缩,而云服务器则进行解码和复杂的LVLM推论,有效地将计算负担从边缘卸下.

blocks.en: 2) LGS-HTP module: To tackle the issue of token redundancy, we propose the LGS-HTP module which first extracts foreground-background priors to decouple tokens, and then jointly selects local semantic tokens and global semantic tokens to perform pruning. It removes redundant tokens while preserving the reasoning-critical semantics.
blocks.zh: (2) LGS-HTP模块: 为解决符号冗余问题,我们提出LGS-HTP模块,首先提取前缘-背景前缘以解析符号,然后联合选择本地语义符号和全球语义符号来进行推敲. 它在保留推理批判语义的同时去除多余的符号.

blocks.en: 3) T-JSCC module: To further reduce token redundancy and mitigate severe transmission distortion of pruned tokens over error-prone communication channels, we design a lightweight T-JSCC module based on an all-linear cascaded projection. Furthermore, we incorporate an SNR-adaptive mechanism to enable channel-aware transmission, ensuring high robustness against varying channel conditions.
blocks.zh: (3) T-JSCC模块: 为了进一步减少信使冗余,并减轻在容易出错的通信通道上对被刷信使的严重传输扭曲,我们设计了一个基于全线级级联投影的轻量级T-JSCC模块. 此外,我们采用了一种适应国家情况评估的机制,以便能够进行了解频道的传输,确保高强度地应对各种频道条件。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. In Section II , we introduce related work on 3D VQA, visual token pruning, and deep joint source-channel coding briefly. In Section III , we systematically introduce the framework of TP-JSCC and mathematically formulate the token pruning and coding problem, based on which we present the proposed TP-JSCC in detail in Section IV . Experimental results and conclusions are given in Sections V and VI , respectively.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 在第二节中,我们介绍3D VQA的相关工作,视觉代币的推算,以及深度的源-通道编码简略. 在第三节中,我们系统地介绍TP-JSCC的框架,并在数学上提出象征性的调试和编码问题,在此基础上,我们在第四节中详细介绍了拟议的TP-JSCC。 实验结果和结论分别载于第五节和第六节。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Framework of the proposed Token Pruning Joint Source-Channel Coding (TP-JSCC). The LGS-HTP module effectively selects global semantic tokens to reduce visual redundancy and achieve a scalable compression ratio. Simultaneously, the T-JSCC module encodes and transmits the selected sparse tokens to maintain transmission robust to complex wireless channel conditions.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1:拟议的Token Pruning联合源码-频道编码框架。 LGS-HTP模块有效选择全局语义符号以减少视觉冗余,实现可缩放压缩比. 同时,T-JSCC模块编码并传输选定的稀有符号,以保持传输稳健到复杂的无线信道条件.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A 3D-VQA
blocks.zh: 二-A 3D-VQA

blocks.en: Existing 3D-VQA methods can be broadly categorized into three paradigms according to the representation modality of the input data: point-cloud-based methods [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , hybrid methods combining point clouds and multi-view images [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] , and multi-view-image-based methods [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] . Specifically, point-cloud and hybrid methods typically employ 3D encoders to extract high-dimensional geometric features for cross-modal fusion. However, their overall performance is severely bottlenecked by the scale and annotation quality of 3D training datasets. For instance, direct 3D point-cloud training is data-starved, as the point-cloud modality in existing high-quality datasets such as ScanQA [ 8 ] contain only about 41,000 point-cloud-text pairs, which is orders of magnitude smaller than 2D datasets (e.g., LAION [ 20 ] includes approximately 5.8 billion image-text pairs). Consequently, these models often struggle to establish robust cross-modal alignment, thereby constraining their generalization capabilities.
blocks.zh: 现有的3D-VQA方法可以根据输入数据的表现方式,大致分为三个范式:点云方法[8,9,10,11],结合点云和多视图图像的混合方法[12,13,14,15],以及多视图图像方法[16,17,18,19]. 具体而言,点云法和混合法一般使用3D编码器来提取高维几何特征,用于跨模式聚变. 然而,由于3D培训数据集的规模和注释质量,它们的总体业绩受到严重瓶颈。 例如,直接的3D点云训练是数据耗尽的,因为ScanQA[8]等现有高质量数据集的点云模式仅包含约41 000个点云文字对,其数量级小于2D数据集(例如LAION[20]包括约58亿个图像文字对). 因此,这些模式往往难以建立强有力的跨模式协调,从而限制了其通俗化能力。

blocks.en: In contrast, multi-view-image-based methods directly process 2D image sequences and leverage the powerful zero-shot capabilities of pretrained LVLMs to perform 3D-VQA reasoning, effectively bypassing the point-cloud-text alignment bottleneck. A representative pipeline, LLaVA-OV [ 18 ] , utilizes the frozen SigLIP [ 21 ] image encoder to extract visual tokens and feeds them alongside text tokens into a pretrained Qwen [ 22 ] model. Motivated by this architecture, cdViews [ 19 ] introduces a lightweight attention-based view selector to replace uniform multi-view sampling, filtering for semantically relevant views to improve reasoning.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,基于多视图-图像的方法直接处理2D图像序列,并利用预先训练的LVLM的强大零射能力来进行3D-VQA推理,有效绕过点-云文本对齐瓶颈. 具有代表性的管道LLaVA-OV [18],利用冷冻的SigLIP[21]图像编码器提取视觉符号,并连同文字符号一起输入一个预先训练的Quen [22]模型. 基于这一架构的动机,cd Views [19] 引入了轻量级的基于注意力的视图选择器,以取代统一的多视图采样,过滤以表达与集成相关的观点,以改善推理.

blocks.en: Given that frequently transmitting all multi-view visual tokens in a cloud-edge collaborative architecture inevitably introduces substantial question-irrelevant redundancy and severely degrades communication efficiency, we adopt the novel multi-view paradigm (cdViews + LLaVA-OV) as our base architecture. Utilizing view selection as a front-end filter, we construct a robust token compression framework upon this foundation to resolve the inherent transmission bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 鉴于经常在云端合作架构中传送所有多视图视觉符号,不可避免地带来大量与问题无关的冗余,并严重降低通信效率,我们采用新的多视角范式(cd Views + LLaVA-OV)作为我们的基础架构. 利用视图选择作为前端过滤器,我们在这个基础上构建一个强大的符号压缩框架,以解决固有的传输瓶颈.

blocks.en: II-B Visual Token Pruning
blocks.zh: II-B 视觉托肯普鲁宁

blocks.en: Although LVLMs have significantly advanced 3D-VQA, their superior capability intrinsically relies on processing a massive number of visual tokens. The direct transmission of these tokens which are semantically redundant [ 23 ] , degrades communication efficiency while simultaneously imposing an unnecessary computational burden on cloud servers [ 24 ] . Consequently, visual token pruning has emerged as an indispensable strategy to jointly minimize both communication payload and LVLM computation overhead.
blocks.zh: 虽然LVLMs已经显著地推进了3D-VQA,但其优越能力在本质上依赖于处理大量视觉符号. 直接传输这些显性多余的代币[23],会降低通信效率,同时给云服务器带来不必要的计算负担[24]. 因此,目视信号探测已成为共同尽量减少通信有效载荷和LVLM计算机顶的不可或缺的战略。

blocks.en: Existing token pruning approaches can be classified into text-dependent [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] and text-independent [ 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] categories. Text-dependent pruning utilizes cross-modal attention mechanisms to measure semantic alignment between visual tokens and textual queries. Although such methods theoretically preserve more task-relevant features, they face a severe operational trade-off: lightweight alignment networks often fail to establish accurate cross-modal connections, increasing the risk of irreversible removal of critical tokens [ 36 ] ; conversely, employing heavy neural networks to enhance alignment precision incurs prohibitive computational overhead [ 26 ] , fundamentally contradicting the objective of pruning.
blocks.zh: 现有代币冲洗法可分为文本依赖[25,26,27,28]类和文本独立[29,30,31,32,33,34,35]类. 依赖文本的浏览利用跨模式的注意机制来测量视觉符号和文本查询之间的语义一致. 虽然这些方法在理论上保留了更与任务相关的特征,但它们面临严重的操作权衡:轻量级配电网络往往无法建立准确的跨模式连接,增加了不可逆地去除关键信号的风险[36];反之,使用重神经网络来提高配电精度则会产生令人望而却步的计算间接费用[26],从根本上违背了挤压的目标.

blocks.en: In contrast, text-independent methods aim to preserve maximum semantic information by assessing token importance via intrinsic statistical properties [ 29 ] . Being predominantly training-free [ 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] , these methods avoid the ambiguity of supervision labels in weakly defined pruning tasks [ 28 ] and provide strong generalization across diverse applications. Motivated by these advantages, we adopt a text-independent strategy to optimize the balance between compression efficiency and deployment generality.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,文本独立方法旨在通过内在统计属性评估象征性重要性来保存最大语义信息[29]. 这些方法以无培训为主[29,30,31,32,33,34,35],避免了在定义薄弱的打压任务中监督标签的模糊性[28],为各种应用提供了有力的概括. 基于这些优势,我们采取文本独立战略,优化压缩效率和部署通用性之间的平衡。

blocks.en: II-C Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding
blocks.zh: II-C 深联合源码

blocks.en: Conventional communication systems founded upon Shannon’s separation principle often suffer from the ‘cliff effect’ in low-latency and finite-blocklength regimes, wherein a slight degradation in channel quality causes an abrupt performance collapse [ 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 ] . In contrast, deep-learning-based JSCC performs end-to-end joint optimization. This paradigm demonstrates superior robustness to variations in communication channel conditions and exhibits graceful rather than catastrophic performance degradation, perfectly aligning with highly dynamic practical error-prone communication channels [ 38 , 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 建立在香农分离原则基础上的常规通信系统往往受到低纬度和有限块长制度的 " 影响 " ,其中信道质量的轻微下降导致突然性能崩溃[37、38、39、40]。 相比之下,基于深层学习的JSC则进行端对端的联合优化. 这一模式表明,在通信渠道条件变化方面,其强势程度高于强势,表现优异而非灾难性的性能退化,与动态性强的、容易出错的通信渠道完全一致[38、41]。

blocks.en: Existing deep JSCC methods are broadly categorized into human-perception oriented [ 38 , 42 , 43 ] and machine-perception oriented [ 44 , 45 ] approaches. The former maximizes high-fidelity pixel reconstruction (evaluated by metrics like Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio, i.e., PSNR), which inherently preserves a massive amount of task-irrelevant information [ 44 ] . Therefore, machine-perception JSCC aligns better with vision tasks by directly transmitting essential semantic features optimized for tasks.
blocks.zh: 现有深入的JSC方法大致分为面向人的认知[38、42、43]和面向机器的认知[44、45]方法。 前者将高纯度像素重建最大化(由峰信号对噪比等度量衡来评价,即PSNR),这在本质上保存了大量与任务无关的信息[44]. 因此,机器感知JSCC通过直接传递对任务最优化的基本语义特征,更好地配合视觉任务.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, applying existing machine-perception JSCC to our cloud-edge LVLM framework faces two obstacles. First, there is a mismatch in representational modality: most existing methods focus on compressing CNN feature maps [ 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 ] , and are not intrinsically designed for the discrete token sequences required by LVLMs. Second, there is a critical mismatch in computational constraints: although a few token-based JSCC schemes have recently emerged [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] , they heavily rely on computationally intensive Transformer architectures and do not take the intra and inter token redundancy into account. Such Transformer-based designs impose unacceptable memory, communication, and computation burdens on compute-sensitive EAs in CE-CP. This precisely motivates our design of a highly streamlined, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based Lightweight Token-JSCC method tailored for robust token transmission under strict edge constraints.
blocks.zh: 然而,将现有的机器认识JSC应用于我们的云端LVLM框架面临着两个障碍。 首先,表示方式存在不匹配现象:大多数现有方法都注重压缩CNN特征地图[44,45,46,47],并非内在为LVLMs所需的离散符号序列设计. 第二,在计算制约方面存在着严重的不匹配:虽然最近出现了一些以符号为基础的JSC计划[4,5,6,7],但它们严重依赖计算密集的变形器架构,没有考虑符号内和符号间冗余. 这种基于变形器的设计给CE-CP中计算敏感的EA带来不可接受的内存,通信和计算负担. 这正促使我们设计一种高度精简的、基于多Layer Perceptoron(MLP)的轻量级Token-JSCC方法,在严格的边缘限制下,专门用于强力信号传输。

Although trainable pruning methods can directly optimize the objective in Eq. ( 8 ), the massive parameter scale of LVLM makes gradient backpropagation exceedingly difficult and incurs prohibitively high training costs. Therefore, we opt for a training-free token pruning approach, which approximates the objective in Eq. ( 8 ) by maximizing the semantic information retained in the pruned tokens. Specifically, cognitive science research reveals that when humans observe complex visual scenes, their perception inherently relies on integrating both local features and global context [ 49 ] . Inspired by this cognitive mechanism, we propose that the selected tokens should capture both the local semantics (i.e., fine-grained details of objects) and the global semantics (i.e., the overall scene context). Therefore, we formulate the pruning process as finding the optimal trade-off ( N loc ∗ , N glo ∗ N_{\mathrm{loc}}^{*},N_{\mathrm{glo}}^{*} ) between the number of local semantic tokens N loc N_{\mathrm{loc}} and the number of global semantic tokens N glo N_{\mathrm{glo}} in 𝒯 N TP \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} , under a fixed pruning budget K K : ( N loc ∗ , N glo ∗ ) = arg ⁡ max ⁡ 𝒰 ⁡ ( ℱ proj ​ ( 𝒯 N TP , loc ∪ 𝒯 N TP , glo ) ) , s.t. ​ | 𝒯 N TP , loc | + | 𝒯 N TP , glo | = N loc + N glo = K \begin{gathered}(N_{\mathrm{loc}}^{*},\!N_{\mathrm{glo}}^{*})\!=\!\arg\max\ \mathcal{U}\Big(\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{proj}}\big(\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP,loc}}\!\cup\!\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP,glo}}\big)\Big),\\

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , building upon the CE-CP defined in Section III , our proposed method directly tackles the transmission bottleneck of massive visual tokens via a highly efficient two-stage strategy.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,在第三节界定的CE-CP的基础上,我们提议的方法通过高效的两阶段战略,直接解决大规模视觉信号的传送瓶颈问题。

blocks.en: First, to fundamentally reduce the communication payload and LVLM computational overhead, we design the LGS-HTP module to achieve token-level compression. Guided by projected tokens 𝒯 P \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}} and priors from a lightweight segmentation network, it performs token pruning on the native tokens 𝒯 N \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}} to obtain a subset of tokens 𝒯 N TP \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} , while preserving both local and global semantics.
blocks.zh: 首先,为了从根本上减少通信有效载荷和LVLM计算高空,我们设计了LGS-HTP模块,以实现符号级压缩. 它以预测的符号T P\ mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}}和轻量级分区网络的前身为指南,在本地符号T N\ mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}获得一个子集的符号T N TP\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}},同时保留本地和全局语义.

blocks.en: Second, to further compress the tokens and transmit them over a noisy communication channel, we introduce the T-JSCC module. At the edge device, it maps the pruned tokens 𝒯 N TP \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} into robust communication channel symbols. At the cloud server, it reconstructs these symbols into reconstructed visual tokens 𝒯 ^ N TP \widehat{\mathcal{T}}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} , which are then projected to 𝒯 ^ P TP \widehat{\mathcal{T}}_{\mathrm{P}}^{\mathrm{TP}} and aligned with the reliably transmitted textual tokens 𝐓 txt \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{txt}} to execute LVLM reasoning and generate the final answer 𝒓 \boldsymbol{r} . The detailed designs of the LGS-HTP and T-JSCC modules are elaborated in Section IV-A and IV-B , respectively.
blocks.zh: 第二,为了进一步压缩信使并通过一个吵闹的通信频道传送信使,我们引入了T-JSCC模块. 在边缘设备上,它将被prushed的符号T N TP\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}映射成坚固的通信通道符号. 在云端服务器上,它将这些符号重建为重建的视觉符号 T^ N TP\glasshat\mathcal{T}}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP},然后投射到 T^ P TP\glassthcal{T}}_{\mathrm{P}}^{\mathrm{TP} 并与可靠传输的文本符号 Ttxt\mathb{T}_{\mathrm{txt} 以执行 LVLM 推理并生成最终答案 r\boldsymbol{r}. LGS-HTP和T-JSCC模块的详细设计分别载于第四节A和第四节B。

blocks.en: The overall pipeline of the LGS-HTP module is illustrated in Fig. 2 . We first extract foreground-background priors (denoted as Pixel Mask in Fig. 2 ) using a lightweight segmentation network, thereby decoupling the original tokens into foreground and background parts. Accordingly, we then introduce a foreground enhancement factor λ bias \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}} to adjust the pruning budgets for foreground and background tokens, resulting in the per-view pruning budgets ( N i fg , N i bg ) (N_{i}^{\mathrm{fg}},N_{i}^{\mathrm{bg}}) . Since the channel dimensions of input tokens vary across LVLMs with different parameter scales, performing pruning directly on the native visual tokens 𝒯 N \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}} (output by the image encoder) enhances the generalization capability of the pruning model. However, the actual inputs to the LVLM are the projected tokens 𝒯 P \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}} . Relying exclusively on 𝒯 N \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}} for pruning would inevitably neglect the inherent semantic requirements of the LVLM, thereby leading to performance degradation (as empirically verified in the ablation study in Section V-D2 ). Therefore, we propose to first determine the pruning selection on 𝒯 P \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}} , and subsequently use these results to guide the pruning of 𝒯 N \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}} . Specifically, utilizing the per-view pruning budgets as constraints, we independently cluster the foreground and background of the projected tokens 𝒯 P \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}} to construct the semantic structure. Based on this, we then jointly select the local and global semantic tokens in 𝒯 P \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}} , yielding 𝒯 P TP \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{P}}^{\mathrm{TP}} , which are then used to guide the pruning of 𝒯 N \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}} , yielding the final pruned token set 𝒯 N TP \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} . The detailed designs of these steps are elaborated in Sections IV-A1 and IV-A2 .

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Foreground-Background Token Decoupling and Budget Allocation
blocks.zh: 前景-背景

blocks.en: In multi-view 2D images, the spatial density of visual information typically exhibits obvious non-uniformity. Foreground regions concentrate intricate spatial structures and high-level semantic attributes of the target objects, thus carrying higher information density. In contrast, background regions predominantly comprise large homogeneous areas with lower information density. Applying uniform pruning overlooks this discrepancy, inevitably discarding critical foreground cues while retaining massive background redundancy.
blocks.zh: 在多视图2D图像中,视觉信息的空间密度通常显示出明显的不一致性. 前景区域集中了复杂空间结构和目标物体的高层次语义属性,从而具有较高的信息密度. 相比之下,背景区域主要包括信息密度较低的大同质地区。 应用统一调试忽略了这种差异,不可避免地丢弃关键的前缘提示,同时保留大量背景冗余.

blocks.en: To address this, we first employ a lightweight U-Net [ 50 ] based segmentation network to segment the input multi-view images. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , this network adopts a classical encoder-decoder paradigm, where skip connections are used to fuse deep semantic features with shallow spatial details. This design efficiently produces a high-quality pixel-wise segmentation mask 𝐌 pix ∈ { 0 , 1 } 384 × 384 \mathbf{M}_{\mathrm{pix}}\in\{0,1\}^{384\times 384} with minimal computational overhead. Here, ‘1’ denotes the foreground region and ‘0’ denotes the background region.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Local and Global Semantics-based Hybrid Token Selection
blocks.zh: IV-A 2 本地和全球语义混合选择

blocks.en: Specifically, the proposed LGS-HTP module comprises two stages: (a) Token clustering to explicitly model the semantic hierarchies, and (b) Hybrid token selection to jointly extract local and global semantics.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,拟议的LGS-HTP模块包括两个阶段:(a) Token集群,明确模拟语义等级;(b)混合符号选择,共同提取本地和全球语义。

blocks.en: (a) Token clustering: Semantic redundancy fundamentally lies in the strong correlations among tokens. To systematically mitigate this, we first independently cluster the foreground and background tokens (as depicted in the ‘Clustering’ stage of Fig. 2 ) based on their feature embeddings to characterize their underlying semantic structures, thereby providing explicit guidance for the subsequent pruning.

blocks.en: IV-B Token Joint Source Channel Coding
blocks.zh: IV-B 托肯联合源频道编码

blocks.en: While the LGS-HTP module effectively eliminates token-level redundancy, significant redundancy exists along the channel dimension of the pruned tokens 𝒯 N TP \mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} . To further mitigate this channel-level redundancy and ensure robust transmission under the limited computational constraints of EAs, we propose a T-JSCC module which achieves end-to-end token compression and noise robustness with strictly bounded on-device overhead.
blocks.zh: 虽然LGS-HTP模块有效消除了符级冗余,但沿着被pruned sorders T N TP\mathcal{T}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}的通道维度存在显著冗余. 为了进一步减少这种信道级冗余,并确保在EAs有限的计算限制下进行强力传输,我们提议采用T-JSCC模块,实现端对端信号压缩和噪声稳健性,并严格限定在设备上层.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 5 , the proposed T-JSCC adopts a symmetric MLP-based encoder-decoder architecture. Crucially, it dynamically incorporates the channel state (SNR) γ \gamma as a conditioning variable, which can be accurately estimated in real time using dedicated equipment and algorithms at the receiver [ 53 ] , thereby providing channel-aware adaptivity across fluctuating channel conditions.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,拟议的T-JSCC采用了基于MLP的对称编码器-解码器架构。 关键是,它能动态地将信道状态(SNR)γ\gamma作为调制变量,在接收器上使用专用设备和算法可以精确地实时估计[53],从而在波动的信道条件中提供信道意识适配性.

blocks.en: Specifically, for an arbitrary token in the i i -th view, denoted as 𝒕 i , n ∈ ℝ D N \boldsymbol{t}_{i,n}\in\mathbb{R}^{D_{\mathrm{N}}} , we concatenate it with γ \gamma to form the network input [ 𝒕 i , n ; γ ] ∈ ℝ D N + 1 [\boldsymbol{t}_{i,n};\gamma]\in\mathbb{R}^{D_{\mathrm{N}}+1} . blocks.en: Imposing a reconstruction constraint only on the native tokens ( 𝒯 ^ N TP \widehat{\mathcal{T}}_{\mathrm{N}}^{\mathrm{TP}} ) is insufficient to guarantee the reconstruction quality of the projected tokens ( 𝒯 ^ P TP \widehat{\mathcal{T}}_{\mathrm{P}}^{\mathrm{TP}} ) obtained via the projection ℱ proj \mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{proj}} . blocks.en: V Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 五. 实验结果

blocks.en: V-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: V-A 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluated our method on the ScanQA [ 8 ] and SQA3D [ 9 ] benchmarks. ScanQA provides ∼ \sim 41K QA pairs covering diverse tasks (e.g., recognition and spatial reasoning), while SQA3D offers ∼ \sim 33K questions emphasizing situated understanding. Given its comprehensive nature, ScanQA serves as our primary testbed for all detailed analyses and ablation studies. Meanwhile, we further evaluate our model on SQA3D to validate its generalizability.
blocks.zh: 我们在ScanQA[8]和SQA3D[9]基准上评估了我们的方法。 ScanQA提供 \sim 41K QA 配对,涵盖多种任务(如识别和空间推理),而 SQA3D 则提供 \sim 33K 问题,强调位置理解. 由于其全面性,ScanQA是我们所有详细分析和研究的主要试验床。 同时,我们进一步评估我们的SQA3D模型,以验证其通用性.

blocks.en: For quantitative evaluation, we employed two complementary metrics: Top-1 Exact Match (EM) and Consensus-based Image Description Evaluation (CIDEr). Top-1 EM strictly measures exact string-matching accuracy, serving as a direct indicator of absolute correctness. Meanwhile, CIDEr evaluates n-gram similarities, providing robustness against synonymous expressions to comprehensively assess semantic consistency and linguistic quality. Throughout our experiments and hyperparameter selection, we jointly considered both metrics to optimally balance strict reasoning accuracy with textual expressiveness.
blocks.zh: 在定量评价方面,我们采用了两个相辅相成的衡量标准:Top-1精确匹配(EM)和基于共识的图像描述评价(CIDER)。 Top-1 EM严格测量精确的字符串匹配准确性,作为绝对正确性的直接指标. 同时,CIDER评价n-gm的相似性,提供与同义词的强性,以全面评估语义一致性和语言质量. 在整个实验和超参数选择过程中,我们共同考虑两种度量衡,以在严格推理精度与文字表达力之间取得最佳平衡.

blocks.en: For all experiments, we employed LLaVA-OV [ 18 ] as the foundational LVLM. As a state-of-the-art (SOTA) open-source LVLM, LLaVA-OV performs excellent in high-resolution visual representation and multi-view reasoning, making it an ideal baseline architecture to validate the effectiveness of our proposed token compression framework.
blocks.zh: 对所有实验,我们使用LLaVA-OV[18]作为基础LVLM. 作为一款最先进的(SOTA)开源LVLM,LLaVA-OV在高分辨率的视觉表现和多视图推理方面表现优异,使其成为验证我们拟议的符号压缩框架有效性的理想基线架构.

blocks.en: V-B Hyper-parameter Settings
blocks.zh: V-B 超参数 设置

blocks.en: Our proposed method involves six user-defined hyper-parameters: the foreground-enhancement bias λ bias \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}} , the global semantic token number per cluster K glo K_{\mathrm{glo}} , the compressed channel dimension D c D_{c} in T-JSCC, the loss weights of T-JSCC λ N \lambda_{\mathrm{N}} and λ P \lambda_{\mathrm{P}} , and the SNR training range for T-JSCC. In the following Section V-B1 to V-B5 , we conduct comprehensive experiments to determine their optimal configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们提议的方法涉及6个用户定义的超参数:前缘-增强偏差 \ lambda { mathrm{bias} , 每个集群的全域语义符号编号 K glo K_{\ mathrm{ glo}}, T-JSCC 的压缩通道维度 D c D_{c} T-JSCC 的减重 N\lambda_{\ mathrm{ N}} 和 P\lambda_{\ mathrm{ P}}, T-JSCC 的 SNR 训练范围. 在下面的V-B1到V-B5节中,我们进行全面的实验以确定它们的优化配置.

blocks.en: V-B 1 Selection of the foreground-enhancement bias λ bias \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}}
blocks.zh: V-B 1 选择前缘增强偏差 \\\ lambda\ mathrm{ bias\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \

blocks.en: This parameter dictates the token budget allocation between the foreground and background. While a higher λ bias \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}} prioritizes critical foreground semantics, an excessively high value disproportionately compresses the background, sacrificing the indispensable global context required for spatial-relation reasoning. To optimally balance foreground salience with contextual preservation, we conduct a grid search for λ bias ∈ { 1.0 , 1.1 , … , 2.0 } \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}}\in\{1.0,1.1,\dots,2.0\} under 90% pruning (Table I ).
blocks.zh: 这个参数决定了前缘和背景之间的象征性预算分配. 虽然更高的QQ偏差\lambda_{\ mathrm{bias}} 优先处理关键的前缘语义,但过高的价值不成比例地压缩了背景,牺牲了空间关系推理所需的不可或缺的全球背景. 为了最佳地平衡前景和背景保护,我们进行一个网格搜索,以查找QQ偏差 {1.0, 1.1, ..., 2.0}\lambda {mathrm{bias}}\in\{1.0, 1.1,\dots,2.0\} 90%以下(表一)。

blocks.en: As observed, performance follows an inverted-U trajectory. Lower values ( λ bias ≤ 1.2 \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}}\leq 1.2 ), retain excessive background redundancy, while higher values ( λ bias ≥ 1.6 \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}}\geq 1.6 ) compromise global spatial context. Both extremes lead to consistent drops in both metrics. Ultimately, performance peaks simultaneously at λ bias = 1.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{bias}}=1.5 , which we establish as the default configuration for all subsequent experiments.
blocks.zh: 正如所观察到的那样,性能遵循了反向U轨迹。 下值(QQ偏差 1.2\lambda {mathrm{bias}}\leq 1.2),保留过多的背景冗余,而较高值(QQ偏差 1.6\lambda {mathrm{bias}}\geq) 1.6) 损害全球空间环境。 这两种极端都会导致两个度量的不断下降. 最终,性能峰值在QQ偏差=1.5\lambda_{\mathrm{bias}}=1.5同时出现,我们确定为所有后续实验的默认配置.

blocks.en: As formulated in Section III , precisely calibrating the number of local and global semantic tokens is critical. Since our method selects only a single local semantic token per cluster, we tune the global semantic token number per cluster, K glo K_{\mathrm{glo}} , under two distinct pruning constraints (80% and 90% ratios) to strike the optimal balance (Table II and III ).

blocks.zh: 表格 II: Kglo K_{\mathrm{glo}}在LGS-HTP中对ScanQA 验证集的80%的符號追蹤效果. 最佳、第二最佳和第三最佳结果分别以粗体、下划线和斜体字突出。

blocks.en: As observed, retaining only local semantic tokens ( K glo = 0 K_{\mathrm{glo}}=0 ) results in insufficient global semantic coverage, which noticeably degrades performance across both metrics and causes a substantial plunge under the extreme 90% ratio. Conversely, allocating an excessive budget to global semantic tokens (e.g., K glo = 3 K_{\mathrm{glo}}=3 or 4 4 ) inevitably weakens key local semantics, similarly leading to performance degradation. In contrast, a moderate allocation ( K glo = 1 K_{\mathrm{glo}}=1 ) exhibits exceptional resilience. Remarkably, at an 80% pruning ratio, LGS-HTP even surpasses the performance of the unpruned baseline. Considering its robust stability across varying constraints, we set the default K glo K_{\mathrm{glo}} to 1, which optimally balances local and global semantics to yield peak performance.
blocks.zh: 正如所观察到的,只保留本地语义符号(K glo = 0 K_{\ mathrm{glo}}=0)会导致全球语义覆盖范围不足,这明显地降低了两个指标的性能,并在极低的90%的比例下导致大幅下滑. 相反,将过多的预算分配给全球语义符号(例如Kglo = 3 K_{\ mathrm{glo}}=3 或 4 4 ),必然会削弱关键局部语义,同样会导致性能退化. 相比之下,适度分配(Kglo = 1 K_{\mathrm{glo}}=1)显示出非凡的韧性。 值得注意的是,以80%的推力比,LGS-HTP甚至超过了未推力基线的性能. 考虑到它在不同限制下的强劲稳定性,我们将默认的 Kglo K_{\ mathrm{ glo}}} 设定为 1, 以最佳地平衡本地和全球语义以产生峰值性能 。

While expanding D c D_{c} enhances reconstruction fidelity, it inevitably incurs a higher communication overhead. Conversely, over-compression severely degrades semantics. To strike a rigorous balance, we evaluate varying D c D_{c} configurations under 90% pruning (Table IV ).

blocks.en: As observed, increasing D c D_{c} consistently improves both evaluation metrics, with the most significant performance gains occurring when scaling from 16 to 64. Further expanding D c D_{c} to 256 yields only marginal improvements but drastically increases the data volume of the compressed tokens. Visualizing these trajectories (Fig. 6 ) reveals a distinct inflection point (i.e., the ‘Elbow Point’) precisely at D c = 64 D_{c}=64 . Consequently, to maximize reasoning accuracy while strictly control the communication payload, we establish D c = 64 D_{c}=64 as the default compressed channel dimension.
blocks.zh: 正如所观察到的,增加Dc DQQC}持续改进了两个评价衡量标准,其中最大的业绩收益是在从16个增加到64个时产生的。 进一步将Dc DQQC}扩大到256只产生微小的改进,但大大增加了压缩令牌的数据量. 可视化这些轨迹(图6)揭示出一个截然不同的折射点(即 " Elbow Point " )正好位于Dc=64 D_{c}=64. 因此,为了在严格控制通信有效载荷的同时最大限度地提高推理精度,我们将Dc = 64 D_{c}=64作为默认的压缩通道维度.

blocks.en: V-B 4 Selection of the loss weight of T-JSCC
blocks.zh: 常规-B 4 选择T-JSCC的损失重量

blocks.en: To determine the optimal balance between the coarse-grained reconstruction error ℒ N \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{N}} and the fine-grained reconstruction error ℒ P \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{P}} , we evaluate weight allocations λ N : λ P \lambda_{\mathrm{N}}:\lambda_{\mathrm{P}} from 10:0 to 0:10 at D c = 64 D_{c}=64 (Table V ).

TABLE V: Effect of the T-JSCC loss-weight setting λ N : λ P \lambda_{\mathrm{N}}:\lambda_{\mathrm{P}} on the ScanQA validation set. The best, second-best, and third-best results are highlighted in bold , underline , and italic , respectively.

As observed, relying exclusively on the coarse-grained constraint (10:0) maintains a reasonable Top-1 EM but severely degrades CIDEr. Conversely, entirely discarding the coarse-grained constraint (0:10) causes a precipitous drop in both metrics. These findings indicate that both fine-grained and coarse-grained losses are indispensable. Furthermore, as the weight of ℒ P \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{P}} is appropriately increased, the CIDEr score exhibits a steady upward trajectory, achieving the peak performance at a ratio of 1:9. Consequently, to optimally balance training stability and semantic fidelity, we designate λ N : λ P = 1 : 9 \lambda_{\mathrm{N}}:\lambda_{\mathrm{P}}=1:9 as the default loss-weight configuration.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,完全依靠粗糙的制约(10:0)保持合理的Top-1EM,但严重降解了CIDEr. 反之,完全放弃粗糙的制约(0:10)会造成两个指标的急剧下降。 这些调查结果表明,精细和粗细的损失都是不可或缺的。 此外,随着L P\mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{P}}的权重得到适当提高,CIDER得分显示稳步上升的轨迹,达到1:9的峰值性能. 因此,为了最佳地平衡训练稳定性和语义忠诚度,我们指定QQ N:QQ P=1:9\lambda_{\mathrm{N}}:\lambda_{\mathrm{P}}=1:9为默认减重配置.

blocks.en: V-B 5 Selection of the SNR training range for T-JSCC
blocks.zh: V-B 5 为T-JSC选择SNR培训范围

blocks.en: To determine the optimal SNR training range, we initially profile the natural 3D-VQA performance degradation over an AWGN channel without joint T-JSCC training (Table VI ).
blocks.zh: 为了确定最佳的SNR培训范围,我们首先在不进行联合T-JSC培训的情况下,在一个特设工作组的频道上描述自然的3D-VQA性能退化(表六)。

blocks.en: TABLE VI: 3D-VQA performance under different AWGN channel SNRs on the ScanQA validation set.
blocks.zh: 表六:ScanQA验证装置上在特设工作组不同频道SNRs下的3D-VQA性能.

blocks.en: As observed, without channel coding, the performance suffers a catastrophic degradation under severe noise conditions (e.g., SNR = 0 dB). As the SNR increases, the performance gradually recovers and eventually saturates beyond 25 dB, indicating that the primary transmission bottleneck is concentrated within the 0 ∼ \sim 25 dB SNR regime. Consequently, we adopted 0 ∼ \sim 25 dB as the definitive SNR sampling range for training.
blocks.zh: 如所观察,没有信道编码,性能在严重噪声条件下发生灾难性退化(如SNR=0 dB). 随着SNR的增加,性能逐渐恢复,并最终饱和度超过25 dB,表明主传输瓶颈集中在0 \\\\\ 25 dB SNR制度内. 因此,我们采用了0\\\\\sim 25 dB作为确定的培训SNR采样范围。

blocks.en: V-C Performance Comparison
blocks.zh: V-C 业绩比较

blocks.en: V-C 1 LGS-HTP Performance
blocks.zh: V-C 1 LGS-HTP 性能

blocks.en: We first compare the proposed LGS-HTP with three representative baseline pruning methods: Farthest Point Sampling (FPS)-based pruning, random pruning, and uniform pruning. The experimental results are summarized in Table VII .
blocks.zh: 我们首先将拟议的LGS-HTP与三种具有代表性的基准测算方法进行比较: 极点采样(FPS)基点采样,随机采样,统一采样. 实验结果摘要见表七。

blocks.en: TABLE VII: Comparison of LGS-HTP with baseline token pruning methods at 80% and 90% pruning ratios on the ScanQA validation set. The best, second-best, and third-best results for each pruning ratio are highlighted in bold , underline , and italic , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表七:将LGS-HTP与ScanQA验证集中80%和90%的基数推算比率进行比较。 以粗体字、下划线和斜体字分别突出显示每个推算比率的最佳、第二最佳和第三最佳结果。

blocks.en: As shown, under 80% pruning, LGS-HTP consistently achieves the best Top-1 EM while maintaining competitive CIDEr scores. Although FPS achieves relatively strong Top-1 EM by retaining richer local semantics, its lack of global semantics leads to a notable CIDEr drop. In contrast, uniform pruning yields the highest CIDEr, because it preserves more comprehensive global semantics, which provides the broad scene context essential for generating the descriptive responses that the CIDEr metric favors. However, its indiscriminate selection weakens local semantic cues, leading to the lowest Top-1 EM.
blocks.zh: 如所示,低于80%的普鲁恩,LGS-HTP在保持竞争性的CIDEr分数的同时,始终取得了最好的Top-1 EM. 虽然FPS通过保留较丰富的本地语义实现相对强大的Top-1 EM,但其缺乏全球语义导致显著的CIDEr下降. 与此相对照,统一推算产生最高的CIDEr,因为它保存了更全面的全球语义,为生成CIDEr衡量偏好的说明性反应提供了必要的大场面。 然而,其不分青红皂白的选择削弱了本地语义提示,导致了最低的Top-1 EM.

blocks.en: Under the more aggressive pruning rate (i.e., 90%), the performance gap becomes more obvious, with LGS-HTP consistently exhibiting superiority over all baselines. It is worth noting that LGS-HTP overtakes uniform pruning in CIDEr scores. This is primarily because under such extreme pruning constraints, the severe loss of local semantics in uniform sampling inevitably pulls down its CIDEr metric. Conversely, our LGS-HTP inherently preserves both local and global semantics, thereby yielding superior overall results.
blocks.zh: 在更激烈的挤压率(即90%)下,性能差距变得更加明显,LGS-HTP在所有基线上始终表现出优越性。 值得注意的是,LGS-HTP在CIDEr的分数中超过了统一打分. 这主要是因为在这种极为困难的制约下,在统一取样中严重失去当地语义必然会降低其CIDER的度量标准。 相反,我们的LGS-HTP本身既保留了地方语义,也保留了全球语义,从而产生了优越的总体结果。

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we then compare LGS-HTP against several recent SOTA token pruning methods on the ScanQA validation set and the SQA3D test set. The performance under 80% and 90% pruning ratios is summarized in Table VIII .
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估我们方法的有效性,我们然后将LGS-HTP与ScanQA验证集和SQA3D测试集上最近的一些SOTA符号推算方法进行比较。 表八概述了80%和90%的套期比率以下的业绩。

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Comparison with SOTA pruning methods on the ScanQA validation set and the SQA3D test set. The best, second-best, and third-best results for each pruning ratio are highlighted in bold , underline , and italic , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表八:与ScanQA验证集和SQA3D测试集的SOTA推算方法的比较. 以粗体字、下划线和斜体字分别突出显示每个推算比率的最佳、第二最佳和第三最佳结果。

blocks.en: As shown, LGS-HTP consistently establishes new state-of-the-art results on the ScanQA dataset across all metrics and pruning constraints. On the SQA3D dataset, we observe an interesting phenomenon at the 80% pruning ratio: our method ranks third, slightly trailing behind PruMerge and DivPrune. This can be attributed to the inherent characteristics of SQA3D, where the ground-truth answers are mainly short phrases. At an 80% pruning rate, global semantics is not yet the primary performance bottleneck, as a relatively small number of tokens can already cover the semantics required for these concise answers. Consequently, other methods that concentrate their token budget heavily on local semantics gain a marginal advantage in this specific scenario.
blocks.zh: 如所示,LGS-HTP在ScanQA数据集方面不断确立新的最新结果,涵盖所有度量和抑制因素。 在SQA3D数据集上,我们观察到一个有趣的现象,在80%的普鲁因比上:我们的方法排名第三,略低于普鲁梅格和迪夫普鲁恩. 这可以归因于SQA3D的内在特征,其中地面真实的答案主要是短句. 在80%的普鲁因速率下,全球语义尚不是初级性能瓶颈,因为相对较少的代词已经可以覆盖这些简明答案所需的语义. 因此,其他将象征性预算大量集中于地方语义学的方法在这一具体情况下获得边际优势。

blocks.en: However, as the pruning rate increases to the extreme 90%, where only a minimal number of tokens is retained, the lack of global semantics becomes the main bottleneck. Under this strict condition, methods that over-emphasize local semantics suffer from severe observation blind spots, leading to noticeable performance drops. In contrast, our LGS-HTP inherently preserves a balanced representation of both local and global semantics. As a result, it maintains stable performance and significantly outperforms all other SOTA methods on SQA3D at the 90% pruning ratio, thoroughly validating the superiority and robustness of our local-global semantic theory in extreme pruning scenarios.
blocks.zh: 然而,随着普鲁士率升至极低的90%,只保留少量的符号,缺乏全球语义成为主要的瓶颈. 在这种严格条件下,过分强调当地语义的方法受到严重观察盲点的影响,导致性能明显下降. 相比之下,我们的LGS-HTP在本质上保持了地方和全球语义的均衡代表性。 因此,它保持了稳定的性能,并大大超过SQA3D上所有其他SOTA方法的90%的普鲁因比,彻底验证了我们本地-全球语义理论在极端普鲁因情景中的优越性和稳健性.

blocks.en: V-C 2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 总体业绩

blocks.en: After validating the efficacy of the LGS-HTP module, we extend our evaluation to the end-to-end performance of the integrated ‘LGS-HTP + T-JSCC’ pipeline. Given the scarcity of token-JSCC methods specifically designed for LVLM-driven 3D-VQA, establishing direct comparisons on the ScanQA validation set is currently unfeasible. Therefore, in this section, we primarily investigate the overall effectiveness of our proposed method, as well as the impact of different SNR training strategies on the model’s noise resilience.
blocks.zh: 在验证了LGS-HTP模块的功效之后,我们的评价扩大到了综合 " LGS-HTP + T-JSCC " 管道的端到端性能。 鉴于为LVLM驱动的3D-VQA专门设计的代号-JSCC方法很少,目前无法对ScanQA验证集进行直接比较. 因此,在本节中,我们主要调查我们拟议方法的总体效力,以及不同的SNR培训战略对模型噪声抗御力的影响。

blocks.en: We first evaluate a baseline strategy that uniformly samples the SNR from 0 ∼ \sim 25 dB during training, named UFM. The corresponding experimental results are presented in Table IX .
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估一个基线战略,在训练期间从0 \\\sim 25 dB对SNR进行统一取样,命名为UFM. 相应的实验结果见表九。

blocks.en: TABLE IX: End-to-end 3D-VQA performance of the proposed method under different SNRs with uniform SNR sampling (UFM) during training on the ScanQA validation set.
blocks.zh: 表九:在ScanQA验证集的培训中,在使用统一的SNR取样(UFM)的不同SNR下,从端到端的3D-VQA对拟议方法的性能.

blocks.en: First, a direct comparison between Table VI and Table IX highlights the critical necessity of our proposed T-JSCC method. Under identical SNR conditions, particularly in extreme low-SNR regimes (e.g., at 0 dB), the integration of T-JSCC yields a dramatic performance improvement over the baseline (boosting the Top-1 EM from a mere 7.55 to 26.97). This indicates that our method successfully mitigates the severe impact of channel noise on 3D-VQA performance.
blocks.zh: 首先,表六和表九之间的直接比较突出表明,我们提议的T-JSCC方法至关重要。 在相同的SNR条件下,特别是在极低的SNR制度(如0分贝)下,T-JSCC的整合比基线(推动Top-1 EM从7.55升至26.97)的性能大有改善. 这表明我们的方法成功地减轻了信道噪声对3D-VQA性能的严重影响.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, further analysis of Table IX reveals that the UFM strategy leaves substantial room for improvement. Notably, as the SNR improves to favorable conditions (e.g., 20 and 25 dB), the performance exhibits a counter-intuitive decline rather than a continuous increase. We attribute this anomaly to the training instability caused by directly mixing high and low SNR samples. Because the reconstruction loss under extreme noise is inherently much larger than that under clean channels, jointly optimizing them with equal probability leads to severe gradient fluctuations. This prevents the model from stably converging across varying channel conditions.
blocks.zh: 然而,对表九的进一步分析表明,UFM战略有相当大的改进余地。 值得注意的是,随着SNR改善为有利的条件(如20和25 dB),性能呈现出反直观的下降,而不是持续的增长. 我们将此异常归因于直接混合高低的SNR样本造成的训练不稳定. 由于极端噪声下的重建损失本质上比清洁渠道下的损失大得多,共同以同等概率优化它们会导致严重的梯度波动. 这使得该模型无法在不同渠道条件下稳定地汇合。

blocks.en: To mitigate this optimization bias, we introduce a progressive (PRG) sampling strategy, adopting an anti-curriculum learning [ 55 ] schedule. During early training epochs, we strictly confine SNR sampling to the high-noise regime (e.g., 0 ∼ \sim 5 dB), compelling the encoder to prioritize noise-robust semantic feature extraction. As training advances, we incrementally expand the sampling range epoch by epoch to encompass the full 0 ∼ \sim 25 dB spectrum. The corresponding experimental results are presented in Table X .
blocks.zh: 为了减少这种优化偏差,我们采用了渐进式(PRG)采样策略,采用反曲线学习[55]时间表. 在早期训练期间,我们严格将SNR采样限制在高噪声系统(如0\\\\sim 5 dB)内,迫使编码器优先进行噪声-气动语义特征提取. 随着训练的推进,我们逐步扩大采样范围,以涵盖完整的0\\\sim 25 dB频谱。 相应的实验结果见表十。

blocks.en: TABLE X: End-to-end 3D-VQA performance of the proposed method under different SNRs with progressive SNR range expansion (PRG) during training on the ScanQA validation set.
blocks.zh: 表十:在ScanQA验证集的训练中,不同SNR下采用渐进的SNR范围扩展(PRG)的3D-VQA端到端的拟方法性能.

blocks.en: A comparative analysis between Table IX and Table X reveals that the PRG strategy significantly enhances the model’s low-SNR resilience. Notably, under severe channel conditions (e.g., SNR = 0 dB and 5 dB), the Top-1 EM achieves substantial improvements. Concurrently, the peak performance is firmly sustained under favorable channel conditions (e.g., SNR = 25 dB). More importantly, instead of the counter-intuitive decline at higher SNRs, the performance now exhibits a stable and consistent upward trajectory as channel conditions improve, successfully resolving the training instability observed in the UFM baseline.
blocks.zh: 表九和表十之间的比较分析显示,PRG战略大大加强了模型的低SNR复原力. 值得注意的是,在恶劣的信道条件下(如SNR=0 dB和5 dB),Top-1 EM实现大幅改善. 同时,峰值性能在有利的信道条件(如SNR=25 dB)下得到稳固维持. 更重要的是,随着信道条件的改善,业绩现在呈现出稳定和一致的上行轨迹,而不是在较高的SNRs出现反直觉下降,成功解决了UFM基线中观察到的训练不稳定.

blocks.en: V-D Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: V-D 读取研究

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct comprehensive ablation studies to validate our proposed method. First, in Section V-D1 , we ablate the core components within the LGS-HTP module to verify their individual contributions. Next, to demonstrate the effectiveness of our strategy (using the projected tokens to guide the pruning of the native visual tokens), we compare the performance of different pruning schemes in Section V-D2 . Finally, to highlight the practical efficiency of our approach, we report the computational overhead of the LVLM before and after integrating our method in Section V-D3 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行全面的废除研究,以验证我们提议的方法。 第一,在V-D1节中,我们放弃了LGS-HTP模块内的核心组件,以核实他们各自的贡献。 接下来,为了展示我们战略的有效性(使用预测的标志来指导本地视觉标志的修饰),我们比较了第五至D2节中不同修饰方案的表现. 最后,为了突出我们的方法的实际效率,我们报告在将我们的方法纳入第五至D3节前后的LVLM的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: V-D 1 Ablation Studies on LGS-HTP module
blocks.zh: V-D 1 LGS-HTP模块的关联研究

blocks.en: To rigidly validate the efficacy of the core components within the proposed LGS-HTP module, we conduct comprehensive ablation studies under the extreme 90% pruning regime (Table XII ). Since local semantic extraction is indispensable for basic reasoning, we separate the ablation variables into: the foreground and background token decoupling mechanism and the initial sampling strategy for global semantics. The corresponding experimental results are presented in Table XI .
blocks.zh: 为了严格验证拟议LGS-HTP模块内核心部分的功效,我们在极低90%的挤压制度下进行全面的挤压研究(表十二)。 由于局部语义提取对于基本推理是不可或缺的,所以我们把语义变量分为:前景和背景符号解联机制以及全球语义的初步采样策略. 相应的实验结果见表十一。

blocks.en: TABLE XI: Ablation study of LGS-HTP components: token decoupling and global semantic tokens selection strategies under 90% token pruning on the ScanQA validation set. The best, second-best, and third-best results are highlighted in bold , underline , and italic , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表格 十一:LGS-HTP组件的缩写研究:在ScanQA验证集上,在90%的缩写下进行符号调试和全球语义符号选择策略. 最佳、第二最佳和第三最佳结果分别以粗体、下划线和斜体字突出。

blocks.en: As shown in Table XI , explicitly decoupling tokens consistently increase performance across all selection strategies. Specifically, when paired with our uniform selection strategy, integrating the decoupling mechanism boosts Top-1 EM by 0.47 and CIDEr by 0.46 compared to the variant without decoupling (line 3). Parallel improvements are also observed under both random and FPS paradigms.
blocks.zh: 如表十一所示,明确脱钩标志不断提高所有甄选战略的业绩。 具体来说,当与我们的统一选择策略搭配时,整合脱钩机制将Top-1 EM提升0.47,CIDER提升0.46,与变体相比没有脱钩(第3行). 在随机模式和FPS模式下也观察到平行改进。

blocks.en: We further compare our uniform sampling against two established baselines: random sampling and FPS. Compared to random sampling, the uniform sampling yields consistent improvements, indicating that explicitly maintaining global semantics outperforms indiscriminate retention. Notably, while FPS yields a marginally higher Top-1 EM (29.16), it results in a severe drop in CIDEr (95.01) compared to the uniform strategy (98.52). We attribute this to the inherent mechanics of FPS: by greedily sampling maximally distant tokens to enforce strict diversity, it tends to over-emphasize local semantics while severely disrupting the global semantics. This omission undermines the comprehensive scene context, which is essential for CIDEr evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们还将我们的统一取样与两个既定基线进行比较:随机取样和FPS。 与随机抽样相比,统一抽样产生一致的改进,表明明确保持全球语义的绩效超过了不加区别的保留。 值得注意的是,与统一战略(98.52)。 我们将此归因于FPS的内在力学:通过贪婪地采样最遥远的符号来强制实施严格的多样性,它往往过分强调本地语义学,同时严重干扰全球语义学. 这一省略破坏了综合场景背景,而综合场景背景对于发展信息网评价至关重要。

blocks.en: In contrast, the proposed uniform selection strikes the optimal balance. By strategically preserving broad global semantics without sacrificing local semantics, it ensures highly competitive Top-1 accuracy while delivering robust CIDEr performance.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,拟议的统一选择达到最佳平衡。 它通过在不牺牲本地语义的情况下从战略上保留广泛的全球语义,确保极具竞争力的Top-1精度,同时提供强劲的CIDER性能.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This paper focuses on a novel token-oriented CE-CP to address the severe computational constraints of EAs and the communication bottlenecks in 3D-VQA tasks over error-prone communication environments. Specifically, we proposed a highly efficient two-stage compression strategy comprising an LGS-HTP module and a T-JSCC module. By leveraging foreground-background priors and a joint selection mechanism for local and global semantic tokens, the LGS-HTP module effectively mitigates semantic redundancy. Subsequently, the T-JSCC module achieves robust, channel-aware token transmission by using an all-linear cascaded architecture and an SNR-adaptive mechanism. Extensive evaluations on the ScanQA dataset indicate the exceptional efficiency and robustness of the proposed method. Notably, our method reduces the edge-to-cloud transmission payload by approximately 180 × \times . The LGS-HTP module incurs less than a 1% CIDEr loss at a 90% pruning ratio, and remarkably, under extreme channel noise (SNR = 0 dB), the end-to-end CIDEr score drops by a mere 4.9% with the help of the proposed T-JSCC module, while saving 90% computational complexity for the LVLM. Our work provides a highly efficient and resilient token-level transmission solution, paving the way for the robust deployment of LVLM in resource-constrained EAs.
blocks.zh: 本文着重介绍一个以新颖的符号为导向的CE-CP,以解决EAs在计算上的严重局限以及3D-VQA任务中相对于容易出错的通信环境的通信瓶颈. 具体而言,我们提出了一个高效的两阶段压缩战略,包括一个LGS-HTP模块和一个T-JSCC模块。 LGS-HTP模块通过利用前景背景前身和本地及全球语义符号的联合选择机制,有效缓解语义冗余. 随后,T-JSCC模块通过使用全线级阶梯架构和SNR适应机制来实现强力的,有通道意识的代号传输. 对ScanQA数据集的广泛评价表明,拟议方法具有特殊的效率和稳健性。 值得注意的是,我们的方法将边缘到云传播有效载荷减少约180xxxxxx时间。 LGS-HTP模块在90%的穿透率下发生不到1%的CIDEr损失,在极端通道噪声(SNR = 0 dB)下,端到端的CIDEr分数在拟议的T-JSCC模块的帮助下只下降了4.9%,同时为LVLM节省了90%的计算复杂度. 我们的工作提供了一个高效和有弹性的信号级传输解决方案,为在受资源限制的EAs中大力部署LVLM铺平了道路。
